name: ERAU Speedcubing Spring 2018

venue.name: Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University
venue.address: 600 S Clyde Morris Blvd Daytona Beach, FL 32114
venue.details: The venue is a large ballroom directly off the atrium of the welcome center on the first floor, to the left as you enter

information:
Results for 2x2x2 Cube, 3x3x3 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx and Square-1 from this competition have been removed. Please see the [incident log](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/13) for more information.

100 person competitor limit. Prepay online only, no refunds for cancellation. Spectators get in free.
